extra.final_summary: Average bill length (mm) by island for Adelie penguins (24 rows used after cleaning): Biscoe = 37.25, Dream = 37.47 (37.4667), Torgersen = 39.21 (39.2091). Data problems found and fixed: (1) island label misspellings "Dram" (2 rows) and "Torgerson" (1 row) were merged into the allowed labels Dream and Torgersen via normalize_labels, per the rules file — those rows were kept, not excluded; (2) 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 9 and 22) were removed with drop_duplicates so they wouldn't double-count. Verified clean: species labels all valid, bill_length_mm fully numeric with no negatives and all values within the rules range [30, 60]. Columns not used by the question (e.g., body_mass_g stored as text like "3,600", sex label variant "FEMALE") were left untouched. Caveat: averages are computed on the cleaned copy; the original file is unchanged.
